# Independent static identity formal

Owned Java 8 declarations retain a package static `<T> T check(T)` helper
inside a generic owner whose independent class formal has a different name.
The owner keeps its complete parameterized interface header.

Frozen raw, typed and method-handle callers check arbitrary raw values, null
branch effects, exact checked and Error identity from callbacks, late caller
casts and returned identity after observer state changes. Source and SDK
provider profiles compare all original definitions, full Signatures and
Exceptions metadata. Wrong programs must be rejected by the same observer.
